meta.name: baoyu-compress-image
meta.description: Compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG with automatic tool selection. Use when user asks to "compress image", "optimize image", "convert to webp", or reduce image file size.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩图片为 WebP 或 PNG 格式，减小文件体积
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要压缩图片或转换格式来节省空间
copy.tagline_en: Compress images to WebP or PNG to reduce file size
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compress images or convert formats to save space

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把图片压缩成 WebP(默认),也可输出 PNG 或 JPEG,自动从可用工具里挑一个来用。既能处理单个文件,也能递归处理整个目录,并回报体积变化,例如 245KB → 89KB。
howto.when: 当你提到「compress image」、「optimize image」等关键词,或要求减小图片文件大小时触发。

say.text: 把 image.png 压缩成 WebP
say.note: 默认质量 80,输出替换原文件

say.text: 压缩 ./images/ 目录里的图片,保留原图
say.note: 递归处理子目录且不覆盖原文件

say.text: 把这张图转成 PNG,质量 75

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude compresses images to WebP (default) or PNG/JPEG, picking the best available tool (sips, cwebp, ImageMagick, Sharp). It handles a single file or a whole directory and reports the size change, e.g. 245KB → 89KB.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "compress image", "optimize image" or similar, or ask to convert an image to WebP or reduce image file size.

say_en.text: Compress the images in ./images/ and keep the originals
Convert this image to PNG at quality 75
